## Chapter 2 · Conservation Equations {#ch2}

| Quantity | Expression | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Continuity (conservative) | $\dfrac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} + \del\cdot(\rho\vect{q}) = 0$ | [§2.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity); any flow, any coordinate system |
| Continuity (Cartesian) | $\dfrac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} + \dfrac{\partial (\rho u)}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial (\rho v)}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial (\rho w)}{\partial z} = 0$ | [§2.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity) |
| Continuity (cylindrical) | $\dfrac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} + \dfrac{1}{r}\left[\dfrac{\partial (r\rho u_r)}{\partial r} + \dfrac{\partial (\rho u_\theta)}{\partial \theta}\right] + \dfrac{\partial (\rho u_z)}{\partial z} = 0$ | [§2.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity) |
| Continuity (non-conservative) | $\dfrac{D\rho}{Dt} + \rho\,\del\cdot\vect{q} = 0$ | [§2.1.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity-nonconservative) |
| Incompressible continuity | $\del\cdot\vect{q} = \dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial w}{\partial z} = 0$ | [§2.1.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity-special); good approximation for $Ma \le 0.3$ |
| Incompressible continuity (cylindrical) | $\dfrac{1}{r}\dfrac{\partial (r u_r)}{\partial r} + \dfrac{1}{r}\dfrac{\partial u_\theta}{\partial \theta} + \dfrac{\partial u_z}{\partial z} = 0$ | [§2.1.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-continuity-special) |
| Momentum, $x$-component (general) | $\rho\dfrac{Du}{Dt} = \rho F_x - \dfrac{\partial p}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial \tau_{xx}}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial \tau_{xy}}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial \tau_{xz}}{\partial z}$ | [§2.2.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-stresses); $\tau_{ij}$ acts in direction $i$ on a $j$-face |
| Newtonian constitutive relations (Stokes) | $\tau_{xx} = \lambda\,\del\cdot\vect{q} + 2\mu\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x},\quad \tau_{xy} = \tau_{yx} = \mu\left(\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)$ | [§2.2.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-stresses); similarly for $y, z$; $\lambda = -\tfrac{2}{3}\mu$ |
| Navier--Stokes (constant $\mu$) | $\rho\dfrac{D\vect{q}}{Dt} = \rho\vect{F} - \del p + \mu\del^2\vect{q} + \dfrac{\mu}{3}\del(\del\cdot\vect{q})$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special); compressible |
| Euler equation (inviscid) | $\dfrac{D\vect{q}}{Dt} = \vect{F} - \dfrac{1}{\rho}\del p$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special); compressible or incompressible |
| Incompressible Navier--Stokes | $\dfrac{D\vect{q}}{Dt} = \vect{F} - \dfrac{1}{\rho}\del p + \nu\del^2\vect{q}$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special); $\nu = \mu/\rho$; constant $\rho$ and $\mu$ |
| Incompressible N--S, $x$-component | $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial t} + u\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x} + v\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y} + w\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial z} = F_x - \dfrac{1}{\rho}\dfrac{\partial p}{\partial x} + \nu\del^2 u$ | [§2.4.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-incompressible-summary); local + convective = body + pressure + viscous |
| Acceleration (cylindrical) | $\dfrac{D\vect{q}}{Dt} = \left(\dfrac{Du_r}{Dt} - \dfrac{u_\theta^2}{r}\right)\uvec{e}_r + \left(\dfrac{Du_\theta}{Dt} + \dfrac{u_r u_\theta}{r}\right)\uvec{e}_\theta + \dfrac{Du_z}{Dt}\uvec{e}_z$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special); centripetal and Coriolis-type terms |
| Material derivative of a scalar (cylindrical) | $\dfrac{D}{Dt} = \dfrac{\partial}{\partial t} + u_r\dfrac{\partial}{\partial r} + \dfrac{u_\theta}{r}\dfrac{\partial}{\partial \theta} + u_z\dfrac{\partial}{\partial z}$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special) |
| Incompressible N--S (cylindrical, $r$) | $\rho\left(\dfrac{Du_r}{Dt} - \dfrac{u_\theta^2}{r}\right) = \rho F_r - \dfrac{\partial p}{\partial r} + \mu\left(\del^2 u_r - \dfrac{u_r}{r^2} - \dfrac{2}{r^2}\dfrac{\partial u_\theta}{\partial \theta}\right)$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special); $D/Dt$ and $\del^2$ act as scalar operators |
| Incompressible N--S (cylindrical, $\theta$) | $\rho\left(\dfrac{Du_\theta}{Dt} + \dfrac{u_r u_\theta}{r}\right) = \rho F_\theta - \dfrac{1}{r}\dfrac{\partial p}{\partial \theta} + \mu\left(\del^2 u_\theta + \dfrac{2}{r^2}\dfrac{\partial u_r}{\partial \theta} - \dfrac{u_\theta}{r^2}\right)$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special) |
| Incompressible N--S (cylindrical, $z$) | $\rho\dfrac{Du_z}{Dt} = \rho F_z - \dfrac{\partial p}{\partial z} + \mu\del^2 u_z$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special) |
| Laplacian (cylindrical, scalar) | $\del^2 = \dfrac{\partial^2}{\partial r^2} + \dfrac{1}{r}\dfrac{\partial}{\partial r} + \dfrac{1}{r^2}\dfrac{\partial^2}{\partial \theta^2} + \dfrac{\partial^2}{\partial z^2}$ | [§2.2.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-ns-special) |
| Momentum (conservative, incompressible) | $\dfrac{\partial (\rho\vect{q})}{\partial t} + \del\cdot(\rho\vect{q}\vect{q}) = \rho\vect{F} - \del p + \mu\del^2\vect{q}$ | [§2.2.3](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-momentum-conservative); constant $\mu$ |
| Fourier's law | $(q_x, q_y, q_z) = -k\del T$ | [§2.3](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-energy); heat flows from hot to cold |
| Energy, total energy $E = e + \lvert\vect{q}\rvert^2/2$ | $\rho\dfrac{DE}{Dt} = \rho\dot{Q} + \del\cdot(k\del T) + \rho\vect{F}\cdot\vect{q} - \del\cdot(p\vect{q}) + W_\tau$ | [§2.3](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-energy); $W_\tau$ = rate of work of the viscous stresses; non-conservative form |
| Energy, internal energy $e$ | $\rho\dfrac{De}{Dt} = \rho\dot{Q} + \del\cdot(k\del T) - p\,\del\cdot\vect{q} + \Phi$ | [§2.3.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-energy-internal); no kinetic-energy or body-force terms |
| Viscous dissipation function | $\begin{aligned}\Phi = \lambda(\del\cdot\vect{q})^2 &+ \mu\left[2\left(\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)^2 + 2\left(\dfrac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)^2 + 2\left(\dfrac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2\right.\\ &\left. + \left(\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial z} + \dfrac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\dfrac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \dfrac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2\right]\end{aligned}$ | [§2.3.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-energy-internal); $\Phi \ge 0$; $\lambda$ term vanishes if incompressible |
| Temperature equation (incompressible, constant $k$) | $\rho C_v\dfrac{DT}{Dt} = \rho\dot{Q} + k\del^2 T + \Phi$ | [§2.4.2](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-incompressible-summary); $e = C_v T$ |
| Conservative form (any conserved quantity $\phi$ per unit mass) | $\dfrac{\partial (\rho\phi)}{\partial t} + \del\cdot(\rho\phi\vect{q}) = \rho\dfrac{D\phi}{Dt}$ | [§2.4.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-conservative-intuition); rate of change + net outflux, per unit volume |
| Couette flow with heating | $\dfrac{T - T_w}{T_\infty - T_w} = \eta + \dfrac{Br}{2}\eta(1 - \eta),\quad Br = \dfrac{\mu U^2}{k(T_\infty - T_w)}$ | [§2.3.1](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-energy-internal); $\eta = y/h$; $T_w$: fixed plate, $T_\infty$: moving plate; interior max. if $Br > 2$ |
| Wall (no slip, no temperature jump) | $\vect{q}_{\text{fluid}} = \vect{q}_{\text{surface}},\quad T_{\text{fluid}} = T_{\text{surface}}$ | [§2.5](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-bcs) |
| Fluid--fluid interface (flat) | $\vect{q}_1 = \vect{q}_2,\quad p_1 = p_2,\quad \mu_1\dfrac{du}{dy}\Big\rvert_1 = \mu_2\dfrac{du}{dy}\Big\rvert_2,\quad k_1\dfrac{dT}{dy}\Big\rvert_1 = k_2\dfrac{dT}{dy}\Big\rvert_2$ | [§2.5](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-bcs); velocity, normal stress, shear stress, heat flux continuous |
| Free surface (liquid below a gas) | $p \approx p_{\text{atm}},\quad \dfrac{du}{dy} \approx 0,\quad \dfrac{dT}{dy} \approx 0$ | [§2.5](../notes/ch2.qmd#sec-bcs); liquid side |
